description: This file defines a PHP class named NotIn that extends AbstractRule. It implements a validation rule to check if a given input is not present in a specified array (haystack). The class is part of the validation rules in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the API version 2 validator rules, and appears to be used for input validation purposes.

classes.name: NotIn
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether a given input value is not contained within a predefined list of values ('haystack'). It supports an option to compare types strictly.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the NotIn validator with a list of disallowed values and an optional strict comparison flag.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation to ensure the input is not in the haystack array, respecting the compareIdentical flag.
